Inside Macintosh: Telephony /
Chapter 5 - Telephone Manager Messages / Telephone Manager Message Reference
Constants

Paging States

The value parameter of the telCAPagingMsg message (page 5-23) indicates the outcome of paging activity. It contains one of the following constants. 
enum {
   telPageEst              = 0,
   telPageComplete         = 1,
   telPageFailed           = 2
};
Constant descriptions
telPageEst
A paging activity has been established.
telPageComplete
The paging activity has completed.
telPageFailed
The paging activity failed.
